verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Ellis Porter publishes an article titled "NIW premium processing: what it speeds up," which suggests it explains what premium processing does and does not accelerate, at least for NIW I-140s. Only the title is evidenced, not the content. Missing for 10: actual article content, which classifications qualify (H-1B, L-1, O-1, etc.), the I-907 fee amount, an explicit treatment of what premium processing does not speed up (e.g., adjustment of status), and independent corroboration.
